objective: Test whether partial error release plus cooldown can preserve short-memory scale alignment while preventing both continuous catch-up and low-frequency large jumps.

PARTIAL_PERSIST2_GAP0P10_F0P50_COOLDOWN2.rule: after two consecutive same-sign gaps with abs(fast_target-governed_scale_previous)>=0.10, move 50% of the current gap toward fast_target, then hold for the next 2 measurements

PARTIAL_DEADBAND0P12_F0P50_COOLDOWN2.rule: when abs(fast_target-governed_scale_previous)>=0.12 and cooldown is inactive, move 50% of the current gap toward fast_target, then hold for the next 2 measurements

ANCHORED_PARTIAL_DB0P12_F0P50_COOLDOWN2_.rule: when abs(fast_target-governed_scale_previous)>=0.12 and cooldown is inactive, define event target as 75% fast_target + 25% slow_target, move 50% toward that anchored target, then hold for the next 2 measurements

selection_rule: A research candidate must pass every gate on Tencent and repeat every gate on Sina. If multiple pass, select lowest mean-absolute-turnover multiple, then lowest q95 multiple, then lowest update fraction.
